name: Xunqueira de Espadanedo (Spain)
description: Dark blue field with a chequy band of red and white from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with two yellow bunches of bulrushes.
history: Municipal flag of Xunqueira de Espadanedo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band chequy of red and white from the upper hoist to the lower fly
bunches of bulrushes at the upper fly and the lower hoist
